### 1 — Scene
A serving of roasted vegetable chunks—apparently potatoes and aubergine/courgette—with a mixed-leaf side salad. The vegetable identification is somewhat uncertain.

### 2 — Vessel
A large, square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation:  
**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².** Food on the plate at the left edge is excluded.

### 3 — Items
Roasted potatoes; other roasted vegetables; mixed salad leaves; small tomato and cucumber pieces; a light coating of oil/dressing.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
Oil is treated as a coating, so its area overlaps the food rather than adding to plate coverage.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Roasted potatoes | 16% | 85 × 1.8 = 153 ml | 0.65 | 99 g | 93 | 92 kcal |
| Other roasted vegetables | 15% | 80 × 1.8 = 144 ml | 0.60 | 86 g | 35 | 30 kcal |
| Mixed leaves | 29% | 154 × 2.7 = 416 ml | 0.13 | 54 g | 20 | 11 kcal |
| Tomato pieces | 3% | 16 × 1.0 = 16 ml | 0.60 | 10 g | 18 | 2 kcal |
| Cucumber pieces | 2% | 11 × 0.8 = 9 ml | 0.60 | 5 g | 15 | 1 kcal |
| Oil/dressing | Overlapping | Thin coating, approximately 9 ml | 0.92 | 8 g | 884 | 71 kcal |

**Coverage check:** 16 + 15 + 29 + 3 + 2 = **65%**, consistent with the substantial empty area toward the top.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **262 g and 207 kcal** is plausible for this modest vegetable-and-salad serving. Oil quantity is the largest energy uncertainty; no meat or other hidden ingredients are assumed.
